story: In the diverse world of birds, the Snow Pigeon (Columba leuconota) stands out. This species, part of the Columbidae family, is a resident of High altitude rocky areas; cliffs; river valleys; and rocky slopes from 2000–5200 m. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Snow Pigeon is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Snow Pigeon and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
